text:
My top pick is the UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W for most people who want to charge a laptop and phone from one compact charger. Based on your pasted results, it offers a strong balance of portability, charging power, and travel convenience.

Best 65W GaN chargers
Best overall

1. UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W

65W · 3 ports · 113 g

Delivers up to 65W to a single device.

Splits power 45W + 20W when charging two devices.

Includes US, UK, and EU plug heads, according to the supplied review.

Best for MacBook Air-class laptops and a phone while traveling.

Buy: UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W · Source and review

Best established alternative

2. Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W)

65W · 3 ports

Two USB-C ports and one USB-A port.

Supports PPS for compatible phones.

Compact design with foldable prongs.

The supplied Newegg result lists it at $29.99, sold by Anker Official Store.

Buy: Anker 735 at Newegg — $29.99 listed · Anker specifications

Best two-pack value

3. Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W

$49.99 · 2-pack

Two USB-C ports and one USB-A port.

Supports USB PD 3.0 and PPS.

Up to 65W when charging one device.

When charging multiple devices, the main USB-C port drops to 45W — fine for a MacBook Air, but potentially limiting for some higher-power laptops.

Buy: Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W two-pack — $49.99 listed · Specifications and offer details

My recommendation

Choose UGREEN if portability and international travel matter most.

Choose Anker if you want a versatile everyday charger at the lowest clearly listed single-charger price.

Choose Baseus if you want one charger for home and another for your bag.

One important caveat: 65W is well suited to many ultrabooks, but some performance laptops need 90W or more. Also, your phone's maximum charging speed depends on its supported charging protocol.

Which laptop and phone do you use? I can narrow this down to the best match for both devices.
